text:
Maria (PM): Heads-up — Asterion Telecom is pressing for a Q3 private deployment. AE says customer expects dedicated pool (8xA100 equiv), KMS + HSM for key management, and audit logs. They asked for a delivery target of 2026-09-15. Need quick feasibility + proposed scope tradeoffs.
Dan (AE): Confirmed — they signed PO contingent on this timeline. Main asks: strict data isolation, customer-managed VPC peering, 99.9% uptime, and <120ms P95 for gen on a 4k context with their fine-tuned model. They said legal will push KMS requirement.
Lee (SRE): Quick Qs: what's model size and token distribution? perf target seems tight for 4k context on single-server config. Do we know if they need synchronous embedding/rerank in the same endpoint?
Dan (AE): Model is ~20B, seq dist peaks at 2.2k tokens, tail to 4k. No embedding in same path, but they do want synchronous rerank option as separate route.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Suggestion: two-phase delivery. Phase 1 (GA): Private control plane + dedicated fleet, KMS support (envelope encryption), basic audit logs, canary rollout to 5% traffic. Set P95 SLO to 150ms initially (with quantized 4-bit + batching heuristics). Phase 2 (post-GA, +6–8 weeks): aggressive kernel tuning, KV cache prewarming, and seq-aware batching to push P95 toward 120ms.
Hannah (Eng): Reality check on infra: KMS + HSM integration and private installer will take about 4 weeks to build + 2 weeks validation for compliance. Dedicated fleet provisioning and testing ~2 weeks. Kernel/quantization work is parallel but needs perf infra and model bench time ~4 weeks. So total on the optimistic path is ~8–10 weeks.
Maria (PM): That aligns with my math. If customer insists on 2026-09-15 (ie ~7 weeks from now), we either: a) narrow scope (no full HSM, provide KMS via partner, higher initial SLO), or b) request timeline extension. We need decision for this week.
Lee (SRE): Operational compromise: offer HSM-as-a-service via partner for GA (meets key separation), with on-prem HSM roadmap. Also enable KV-prefetch and smaller batch windows to lower tail latency. But P95 120ms for 20B at 4k is ambitious without model-level optimizations -> will require quant+custom kernels.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Draft rollout snippet for proposal we can share with AE/Customer:
```
Phase 1 (GA, target 9/15): Private control plane, dedicated pool (8x), KMS via partner, audit logs, 5% canary -> SLO P95 150ms
Phase 2 (+6 weeks): HSM option, kernel optimizations, model quantization tuning -> target P95 120ms
Fallbacks: automatic route to hosted smaller-quant model if Dedicated capacity unavailable
```
Dan (AE): I'll present that to Asterion tomorrow. They made it clear 9/15 is a hard cut if legal doesn't push back. We should list the caveats in the SOW.
Hannah (Eng): Action items from eng side: implement KMS partner integration (owner: Hannah) — due 2026-08-20; dedicate perf infra + bench runs (owner: Lee) — due 2026-08-28; quant + kernel spike (owner: Hannah + Eng infra) — 2026-09-12 for initial results.
Maria (PM): OKRs / launch criteria to propose in SOW: 
- Delivery: Private control plane + dedicated pool deployed to customer VPC by 9/15 (or updated date)
- Security: KMS-integration documented + audit logs enabled
- Reliability: 99.9% uptime SLA for Dedicated pool
- Performance: P95 <= 150ms GA, roadmap to 120ms in 6 weeks
- Rollout: 5% canary + automatic rollback triggers
(Need signoff from Sales/legal on the SLO wording)
Lee (SRE): Small nit: SLA 99.9% for Dedicated is doable but requires runbook + on-call escalation and a capacity buffer. Put 5% buffer in the SOW to avoid overcommit.
Dan (AE): Noted. I'll propose the buffer and the phased SLOs. Also will ask Asterion if they can accept partner KMS for GA.
Maria (PM): Can eng commit to the dates above if we push GA to 9/22 instead of 9/15? That gives +1 week for KMS validation.
Hannah (Eng): 9/22 looks comfortable for Phase 1 with partner-KMS. If legal or customer insists on full on-prem HSM day-one, we need +3–4 weeks.
deploy-bot: canary created for asterion-demo on dev cluster (id: canary-ast-01) :rocket:
Maria (PM): Final ask — Dan, confirm customer accepts phased plan by EOD tomorrow. Hannah/Lee, I'll kick off a private ticket with infra details so we can track the SOW items. I'll put a short summary in the account tracker after Dan confirms.
Dan (AE): Will confirm tomorrow. :thumbsup:
